submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the exact N11 running sprite to edit. Make ONLY a local right forearm/wrist/fan swing correction. Preserve all of image 1 outside that area, especially every leg and boot pixel, head and torso. Image 2=N10 previous frame, image 3=N12 following frame. Image 4 identity; image 5 visual style.

N11 must be BETWEEN the low fan in image 2 and the high fan in image 3. The fan in this new N11 must sit OUT TO THE RIGHT AT WAIST HEIGHT, held SIDEWAYS, NOT UP ABOVE THE SHOULDER. Move the right fist to about (950,700) on the 1254 canvas, level with the lower waist/right elbow: clearly LOWER than the right fist in image 3. The right forearm slopes a little DOWN and outward from the fixed shoulder. Natural elbow and wrist, right hand grips fan pivot firmly. Left hand stays empty and absolutely unchanged.

VERY IMPORTANT FAN ORIENTATION: show the open fan like a SIDEWAYS D-SHAPE to the right of the fist. Its pivot/black ribs meet at the LEFTMOST point near (950,700); the curved outer fan edge is at the RIGHT (around x=1175). The fan's radial center line points almost horizontally RIGHT with only a slight upward tilt. Its two outer straight ribs go diagonally up-right and down-right, so the two fan corners are roughly (1100,560) and (1100,855), and the rounded leaf's bulging edge is on the far right. Do NOT draw the usual upright fan with the curve on TOP and pivot at the bottom. Do NOT raise the wrist to shoulder height. This sideways waist-level fan is the halfway rotational phase bridging N10's down-right fan and N12's up-right fan. Keep fan fully opened and the same blue water-dragon artwork, white/gold leaf and black ribs. Blue tassel hangs from the pivot naturally. No cloning another frame.

Lock image 1: exact north-facing back view, head/hair, torso/spine/belt, left arm and empty hand, robe below waist, thighs, knees, trousers, ankles, planted straight north-pointing right boot and raised left sole. Keep all body/feet coordinates, camera scale, composition, ground contact and foot anatomy unchanged. No resizing, no image-wide shifting, no facing change. Single native 1254x1254 RGBA transparent sprite with all parts in frame; no background, floor, shadow, effects, text, watermark or collage.
